about: wc-001 lab falsifiers. Each one plants a bug in the capsule source or the build script and requires its named test to FAIL (error-free). F-WC1 embeds an absolute build path so the two clean builds differ; F-WC1-SPACED-PATH splits the remap flags on a space in the build path; the rest change the digest result, retain an import, alter the digest signature, record a wrong toolchain/hash in the receipt, or name a compiler other than the one Cargo was told to use. command is "lab" and file paths are relative to examples/agent-host/, so a lab file is ../../lab/wasm-capsule/... . The canonical runner falsify.py has no "lab" command yet (ask R1), so these are proved by the repo's break -> named test fails -> revert method with `cargo test` in the lab workspace until R1 lands.

the digest export signature is altered to take a second parameter
